rationale.conceptual: The model requires implementing Equations (3)-(5), understanding semiconductor defect physics, workfunction, dipoles, and self-consistent placement. It is an established but non-trivial multi-part algorithm that demands careful translation of physics into code.
rationale.execution: Only two sequential steps: generate raw placement data, then compute ensemble statistics and fit distributions. Standard Python libraries (NumPy, SciPy) suffice; no external tooling, environment setup, or complex data fetching. The solve script runs a single Python file.

The method is non-trivial but well-documented, involving physics equations, parameter sweeps, and a Monte Carlo placement algorithm. The pipeline is simple, with only two sequential steps that can be implemented in a single script. No heavy resources needed; small 3D mesh and 100-sample ensembles compute quickly on CPU.
